pages.text: Let's play a game with Bix!
Bix says: wave your hand. Hello!
Bix says: move your arms up and down.
Bix says: stand on one leg. Can you do it?
Bix says: touch your foot. Good!
Bix says: touch your hair. Oh! Bix has got no hair! Ha, ha!
Now smile with your face. Well done!
